card.title: CreditFlow QE
card.description: A transactional credit-card simulator with independent Java, Cucumber and REST Assured automation, plus executed CI and browser-test evidence.

inspection.summary: Explore synthetic accounts, post purchases and payments, and inspect the source, test framework and verified execution evidence.

facts.label: Backend
facts.value: Java 21, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL and Flyway; exact money, atomic ledger updates and original receipt replay.

facts.label: API automation
facts.value: Independent Cucumber/REST Assured HTTP tests, JUnit Jupiter and a separate TestNG module.

facts.label: UI and CI
facts.value: Java Selenium/Playwright, Bruno and GitHub Actions. Jenkins pipeline executed on an isolated local controller.

technicalHighlights: Independent Java/Cucumber automation validates a real transactional credit-card API.
Real PostgreSQL rollback, ownership, idempotency and concurrency checks.
Custom-host HTTPS, isolated synthetic sessions and genuine test evidence.

paragraphs: An AI-assisted synthetic banking application and independent automation framework built for reproducible engineering and interview practice.

Source CI verifies 31 unit tests, 18 real PostgreSQL integration tests and 31 Cucumber scenarios in each private/public mode. The custom-host release passed 10 banking checks and the complete 11-test Java UI/BFF module.

Synthetic data only; no real cards, funds, settlement or regulatory-compliance claim. Sessions expire after 30 minutes, public quotas are conservative and idle services can take time to wake. Local Jenkins execution is recorded; sustained-load behavior and availability/SLA remain unverified.
